testCase:
T-04: A search box that filters as you type
Goal: Open the contact Felix Tanaka in Vienna.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/t-04/
STEP 2: Fill "Search contacts" with "Tanaka Vienna"
STEP 3: Click "Open" in the only row left in the table
STEP 4: Verify "Opened Felix Tanaka (Vienna)" is visible

steps.note: Trigger filtering by typing without submitting.
Verify only one contact-opening control remains after filtering.
Verify the requested contact was opened.

reasoning: Test that typing “Tanaka Vienna” filters contacts to Felix Tanaka in Vienna and allows opening that contact. Check that only one Open button remains before opening the matching row, then assert the exact confirmation text.
